turn.content: The contract fixes VAT at 11% of subtotal. The invoice charged 12% (1,562,400 / 13,020,000 = 0.12), so the rate applied was wrong.

tool_calls.name: submit_report
tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "tax_mismatch", "line": null, "cause": "wrong_tax_rate", "evidence": [{"kind": "invoice", "ref": "OSC26100537", "detail": "Tax stated 1562400 on subtotal 13020000, i.e. 12%, not the 11% required (which would be 1432200)."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-012#3.1", "detail": "Each invoice carries VAT at 11% of the subtotal, which is the tax base."}, {"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0292", "detail": "PO lines match the invoice lines in quantity and unit price; the discrepancy is confined to tax."}], "explanation": "The invoice applied a 12% tax rate (1562400 on 13020000), whereas clause KTR-V-012#3.1 fixes VAT at 11%, giving 1432200."}]}
